mapper.select: SELECT sip.`path`, sip.`name` FROM sys_interface_permission sip JOIN rel_role_interface rri ON sip.id = rri.interface_id JOIN sys_role sr ON rri.role_id = sr.id AND sr.del_flag = 0 JOIN rel_user_role rur ON rri.role_id = rur.role_id WHERE sip.need_auth = 1 AND sip.del_flag = 0 AND rur.user_id = 1;

SELECT id, avatar, username, password, phone, email, del_flag, create_time, update_time FROM inf_user
AND email like concat('%', #{listUserInfoDTO.email}, '%')
AND phone like concat('%', #{listUserInfoDTO.phone}, '%')
AND username like concat('%', #{listUserInfoDTO.username}, '%')
